level_1.title: Lesson 1: Silicon Step
level_1.hint: The green key can be used as many times as you want! Collect all 8 chips to open the socket to the exit.

level_2.title: Bridge Over Troubled Water
level_2.hint: Push dirt blocks into water to build a solid bridge, then grab the Flippers in the south!

level_3.title: Skating Rink & Corner Banks
level_3.hint: Use the banked ice corners to ricochet to the Ice Skates in the southeast, then collect the chips freely.

level_4.title: Conveyor Chaos & The Thief
level_4.hint: Suction and Fire Boots protect you, but the Thief guarding the south passage will confiscate all your boots!

level_5.title: Beetle & Tank Command
level_5.hint: Step on the blue button to reverse the Tank onto the brown button and hold the trap open!

level_6.title: Toggle Matrix & Clone Factory
level_6.hint: Green buttons toggle walls open and shut. The red button clones dirt blocks to bridge the water channel!

level_7.title: Quantum Teleporters & Illusions
level_7.hint: Some blue walls are illusions! Security creatures cannot step onto gravel.

level_8.title: Epoxy Core: Elemental Gauntlet
level_8.hint: Master all four elemental boots before crossing the thieves to unlock the final core!

level_9.title: Laser Panels & Phantom Walls
level_9.hint: Thin panel walls block only one edge of a tile. Probe the appearing walls to discover the gaps!

level_10.title: Lynx Grandmaster
level_10.hint: Combine the green master key, teleporters, and dirt bridges to gather all 8 master chips!

level_11.title: Cryogenic Rings
level_11.hint: Grab the green master key in the north and Ice Skates in the south center to conquer the double ice spiral!

level_12.title: High-Voltage Chambers
level_12.hint: Each locked chamber holds the key to the next. Watch out for the Pink Ball and Walker!

level_13.title: Magma Core
level_13.hint: Equip the Fire Boots and Flippers in the north before crossing the furnace and water moat!

level_14.title: Synchronous Matrix
level_14.hint: Green buttons on the left and right alternate the toggle corridors to unlock all 8 chips.

level_15.title: Citadel of Epoxy
level_15.hint: The ultimate test: combine elemental boots, keys, and the central ice vault to collect all 10 chips!

default.hint: Use the Objective button (or H) to locate the next mechanism and inspect trap, cloner, and toggle wires.
